description: A well-known hillfort that appears to have originated shortly before the Roman conquest and was occupied through to the 3rd or 4th CE. A Bronze Age barrow is present within the site, which the excavator assumed to be coincidental, but the RSRB points out a parallel at Braich-y-Dinas which has been interpreted as a possible shrine.
